9.text: I arrived at La Favorita without having any idea who to hire, only because of the Google reviews, and I couldn't be happier with my kitchen and my pantry. Patricia is a great professional, she gets your idea quickly, adapts to your needs and advises you if you are wrong about any idea. Everything turned out exactly as we had designed in the render and within the deadlines. Then we have Jonathan who is the executor, they work phenomenally and are very detailed. Honestly, I couldn't have fallen into better hands. Infinite thanks to both.

item1.question: Are the kitchens custom-made or pre-designed models?
item1.p1: We design and manufacture kitchens <0>100% custom-made</0>. Although we have inspiring concepts and layout references as a starting point, each project is designed from scratch to adapt with total precision to the architecture of your home and your daily routines.
item1.p2: We do not limit ourselves to fitting standard catalog modules. We meticulously plan the storage capacity of each area, the interior configuration of drawers and pull-outs, the direction of opening doors, advanced hardware systems, height ergonomics and overall proportions.
item1.p3: Your kitchen is created to actually work in your house, not to meet the standards of a predefined catalog.

item2.question: What does the project include?
item2.header: We offer a <0>comprehensive turnkey service</0> that covers from the initial idea to the final finish:
item2.li1: <0>Consultation and Concept:</0> We meet to understand your lifestyle, usage needs and aesthetic preferences.
item2.li2: <0>Technical Measurement:</0> We perform an exact and professional in-situ measurement to avoid any margin of error.
item2.li3: <0>3D Design and Visualization:</0> We prepare a realistic three-dimensional proposal so you can see and perfect the kitchen before starting production.
item2.li4: <0>Manufacturing and Installation:</0> We produce each piece to high standards and install it using our team of specialized installers for a millimeter-perfect fit.

item3.question: How long will I be without a kitchen during the installation?
item3.p1: We minimize transition times to mitigate inconvenience in your daily life. The installation is meticulously planned in advance, coordinating delivery and assembly times efficiently.
item3.p2: Our goal is to make the process fast, organized and clean, allowing you to enjoy your new kitchen in the shortest possible time without compromising high precision in the finishes.

item4.question: What brands do you work with?
item4.header: We exclusively select top-tier brands that guarantee durability, ergonomics and resistance to continuous daily use:

box1.title: Surfaces and Countertops
box1.text: We work with high-end and highly durable countertops such as <0>Silestone</0>, <1>Dekton</1>, <2>Corian Solid Surface</2> and <3>Compac</3>.

box2.title: Mobiliario y Acabados
box2.text: We use advanced technology panels from <0>Alvic</0> to achieve impeccable finishes and front panels resistant to wear.

box3.title: Hardware and Systems
box3.text: We equip our modules with systems from the Austrian firm <0>Blum</0>, recognized for the smoothness and soft-closing in drawers and doors.

box4.title: Appliances
box4.text: We integrate equipment adapted to your kitchen style with trusted brands such as <0>Bosch</0>, <1>Siemens</1>, <2>Franke</2>, <3>Teka</3>, <4>Balay</4> and <5>Fagor</5>.

item4.note: * The final selection is defined in a personalized way during the project phase based on design, technical requirements and budget.

item5.question: What happens if I need an adjustment or a problem arises with the kitchen?
item5.p1: Your long-term peace of mind is our priority. If over time you need to recalibrate a door, check the sliding of a drawer or correct a soft-close system, our after-sales service will take care of resolving it.
item5.p2: In addition, all components and countertops have their corresponding official warranty, managed directly by our team to avoid intermediaries and inconvenience.

item6.question: How does financing work?
item6.p1: We offer attractive flexible financing options of up to <0>96 months</0> so you can accommodate the payment of your project with total comfort. This facility is subject to approval by the collaborating financial entity.
item6.p2: We explain all conditions transparently and without fine print at the time of delivering the detailed quote, ensuring that everything is perfectly defined before starting.
